mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed nerves and blood vessels reaching the same muscles, connecting earlier discoveries.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive tract and urinary organs into their named slots was straightforward but felt more like assembly than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: The repaired skin segment filled only a small opening, with its scar still visible; the rest of the covering was supplied rather than made from the segment.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though some fittings mainly followed the named goals and slots rather than requiring much inference.

continue.text: I would probably stop here: the final body feels like a natural ending, and several late assembly steps were predictable, even though seeing the connections was worthwhile.
